details:
I would like VRChat to support multi-device audio output, so each audio bus can be sent to a different playback device (including virtual audio cables).

This is mainly useful for videographers, and I understand it may be costly to implement. Please only consider it when you have spare bandwidth.

It is not a high-priority request for everyday play.

The idea is to keep the existing volume buses and add an optional output-device assignment for each one: Master/UIMenu/World/Voices/Avatars/ItemsEffects

If each bus can be routed to its own virtual audio device, creators can capture them as separate tracks in OBS.

OBS recording supports up to 6 audio tracks.

This would help most with one-time recordings, such as events, where a retake is impossible.

After the event, the editor could still adjust voices, world audio, avatar sounds, and so on without being locked into a single mixed track.

A simple version would already help: keep the current mixed output for normal listening, and optionally send individual buses to additional devices.

Even routing only some buses separately would be useful.

Thank you for considering this when time allows.
title: Per-bus audio output to separate devices
